@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M4B3V22A3PCQRESESTYBQ2FH
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8680'
+title: 'Ordinal: fractional index'
+---
+## What
+Task order in a column. The basis is plan.md §6 (Ordinals) and §10 step 4.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Model/Ordinal.swift`: fractional index (Figma algorithm), lowercase hex, default `"80"`. Functions `first`, `after(_:)`, `before(_:)`, `between(_:_:)`.
+- Invalid input gives `INVALID_ORDINAL`.
+- Byte compatibility with Rust is not necessary.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `between(a, b)` sorts strictly between `a` and `b` for all valid inputs.
+- [ ] 1000 inserts at the same position keep a strict order.
+- [ ] An invalid ordinal gives `INVALID_ORDINAL`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Model/OrdinalTests.swift`: port the behavior cases of `../swissarmyhammer/crates/swissarmyhammer-kanban/src/types/position.rs`, plus a property test over random inserts.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter OrdinalTests`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
